If ${x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}+{x}_{3}{a}_{3}=b$, then we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}]+{x}_{3}[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -9 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ 0 \\ {x}_{1}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} \\ 3{x}_{2} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -9 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3} \\ 3{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3} \\ {x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ -9 \\ 1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding components, we get the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=-1 \\ 3{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=-9 \\ {x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=1\end{aligned}
$$

We will solve this system using Gaussian elimination. First, we write the augmented matrix for this system:

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -9 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the augmented matrix, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}M & =[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -9 \\ 1 & 1 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-1){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & 3 & -9 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & 2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=-\frac{1}{2}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 & 3 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & 1 & -3 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

 

The system is now 

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3}=-1 \\ {x}_{2}+{x}_{3}=-3 \\ {x}_{3}=-1.\end{aligned}
$$

 

From the third equation, we get ${x}_{3}=-1.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
{x}_{2}+(-1)=-3\,⟹\,{x}_{2}=-2.
$$

Finally, by substituting ${x}_{2}=-2,{x}_{3}=-1$ into the first equation, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3} & =-1 \\ {x}_{1}+(-2)+3(-1) & =-1 \\ {x}_{1}-5 & =-1 \\ {x}_{1} & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the solution of the system is ${x}_{1}=4$, ${x}_{2}=-2$, and ${x}_{3}=-1,$ which means 

$$
4{a}_{1}-2{a}_{2}-{a}_{3}=b.
$$

Consequently, 

$$
{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{3}=4+(-2)-(-1)=3.
$$
